slug: 2024-09-18 Seychelles Makes Digital ID Mandatory for Work Permit Holders

systems.owner: Department of Immigration and Civil Status (for the virtual ID)
systems.tiers: web and mobile app; launched 1 November 2022, virtual ID compulsory for new work permit holders from 17 September 2024
online; certificates delivered by email and saved in the user's digital wallet

note: Secondary reporting of the same launch: an identity system and a certificate portal, neither a civil-class system, and nothing on how a birth or death is registered.
